name: Tortang Tuna
imageCredit: Photo: Judgefloro, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Drain the tuna and flake it with a fork.
Beat the eggs, then mix in the tuna, minced garlic, and chopped onion.
Heat oil in a pan and pour in half the mixture to form a patty.
Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden. Repeat with the rest.

name: Ginisang Monggo
imageCredit: Photo: Pandakekok9, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Boil the monggo in 6 cups of water for 30 to 40 minutes until soft.
In another pot, saute garlic, onion, and tomato in oil.
Add the cooked monggo with its water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the malunggay leaves, season with salt, and serve.

name: Ginisang Sardinas with Egg
imageCredit: Photo: ProjectManhattan, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute garlic and onion in oil until soft.
Add the sardines with the sauce and break them up lightly.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until the eggs are set.
Serve hot with rice.

name: Tokwa't Itlog
imageCredit: Photo: Choo Yut Shing, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Cook the rice. Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then peel and slice.
Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in oil until golden on all sides.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, and chopped onion to make the sawsawan.
Serve the tofu and eggs over rice with the sawsawan on top.

name: Chicken Breast Adobo
imageCredit: Photo: dbgg1979, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Cut the chicken breast into chunks.
Saute the garlic in oil, then add the chicken and brown it lightly.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper, and half a cup of water.
Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until the sauce thickens.

name: Chicken Tinola
imageCredit: Photo: Obsidian Soul, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute ginger, garlic, and onion in oil.
Add the chicken and cook until it is no longer pink.
Pour in 5 cups of water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the papaya and cook for 5 minutes, then add malunggay and serve.

name: Arroz Caldo
imageCredit: Photo: Wide Awake!, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute ginger, garlic, and onion in oil, then add the chicken.
Add the rinsed rice and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in 8 cups of water and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Hard-boil the eggs, then serve one on top of each bowl.

name: Ginisang Okra with Egg
imageCredit: Photo: Raymund Macaalay, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Slice the okra into rounds.
Saute garlic, onion, and tomato in oil until soft.
Add the okra and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir until set. Season with salt.

name: Tortang Talong
imageCredit: Photo: whologwhy, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Grill or boil the eggplants until soft, then peel off the skin.
Flatten each eggplant with a fork, keeping the stem on.
Beat the eggs with minced garlic and chopped onion.
Dip each eggplant in the egg and fry 2 to 3 minutes per side.

name: Sinigang na Bangus
imageCredit: Photo: Copperhead02, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Boil 6 cups of water with the tomato, onion, and tamarind for 10 minutes.
Mash the tamarind, strain the soup, and bring it back to a boil.
Add the radish and sitaw and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the bangus and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the kangkong, season with fish sauce, and serve.

name: Pinakbet
imageCredit: Photo: Shubert Ciencia, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute garlic, onion, and tomato in oil, then brown the ground pork.
Add the squash and half a cup of water. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the ampalaya, eggplant, okra, and sitaw.
Cook for 7 minutes until tender, season with fish sauce, and serve.

name: Ginisang Giniling
imageCredit: Photo: Ralff Nestor Nacor, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Dice the potato and carrot into small cubes.
Saute garlic and onion in oil, then brown the ground pork.
Add the tomato sauce, soy sauce, potato, carrot, and half a cup of water.
Simmer for 15 minutes, add the peas, and cook for 3 more minutes.

name: Tapsilog
imageCredit: Photo: Maffeth.opiana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Marinate the beef in soy sauce, vinegar, half the garlic, and pepper for 30 minutes.
Cook the rice, then fry it with the rest of the garlic to make sinangag.
Pan-fry the beef until browned and the marinade is gone.
Fry the eggs sunny side up and serve with the beef and garlic rice.

name: Chicken Afritada
imageCredit: Photo: Ralff Nestor Nacor, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute garlic and onion in oil, then brown the chicken.
Add the tomato sauce, fish sauce, and 1 cup of water. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the potato and carrot and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the bell pepper, cook for 3 minutes, and serve with rice.

name: Chicken Sopas
imageCredit: Photo: Darwgon0801, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Boil the chicken in 6 cups of water for 15 minutes, then shred it and keep the broth.
Saute garlic and onion in oil, then add the shredded chicken and carrot.
Pour in the broth, bring to a boil, and add the macaroni. Cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cabbage and evaporated milk, season with fish sauce, and serve.

name: Bistek Tagalog
imageCredit: Photo: Aerous, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Marinate the beef in soy sauce, calamansi juice, garlic, and pepper for 30 minutes.
Fry the onion rings in oil until soft, then set them aside.
Sear the beef in the same pan, then add the marinade and half a cup of water.
Simmer for 15 minutes and top with the onion rings.

name: Inihaw na Manok
imageCredit: Photo: Obsidian Soul, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Mix calamansi juice, vinegar, soy sauce, crushed garlic, and grated ginger.
Marinate the chicken for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-grill the chicken 6 to 8 minutes per side, brushing it with oil.
Slice and serve with the leftover marinade boiled as a sauce.

name: Lugaw with Egg
imageCredit: Photo: Ralff Nestor Nacor, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
steps: Saute ginger and half the garlic in oil, then add the rinsed rice.
Pour in 7 cups of water and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Hard-boil the eggs. Fry the rest of the garlic until golden.
Season with fish sauce and top each bowl with an egg, fried garlic, and spring onion.
